Audit des 5 worktrees existants : tous STALE (répertoires supprimés du disque, 0 commit non déjà contenu dans main). Fichier résiduel reconfirmé SAFE_TO_REMOVE, non supprimé. Verdict : RELEASE_CANDIDATE_READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS.

18_commit_preview.PROPOSED_COMMIT_MESSAGE:
feat: add xfoot promoter referral platform

Adds a referral/affiliate program: personal promoter links, referral
attribution on signup, and 40% commission on actually-confirmed Chariow
payments (never on signup/checkout alone). Commission is created only
from the existing verified successful.sale webhook, is idempotent, and
is reversed (never deleted) on refund/revocation. Promoter and admin
dashboards enforce authorization server-side. 5 new additive tables;
no existing table modified; AI engine untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
